reviews.comment: Oh man this guy is awesome!! McFarland really cares about his students and wants them to succeed, which is hard to come by. He has so much experience from his career outside of teaching that he applies to the course content so well. Lectures are super engaging and not full of unnecessary BS-- he doesn't waste time and truly wants you to learn!

McFarland is the best professor I've ever had in mays. One of the kindest people you'll ever meet. Turns a boring 466 class into an engaging environment. Very generous with grading, curves exams as well. Cannot recommend him enough. Class is “tech free” so get ready to hand write notes. Make a quizlet before exams and you'll be good for an easy A.
Ken is the best professor you will take in Mays. His class is definitely hard and a lot of work, but the best class I've taken. Couldn't speak more highly about him.

Very useful class and smart guy, but he acts like this is our only class. So much outside reading and work that you are constantly working on this class. He has engaging lectures, but get ready to work in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I LOVE KEN!! His class was by far my favorite at A&M. It was a difficult class with a large semester project, but reading the book will help you succeed. Ken is very caring and is always available outside of class. He has a few bonus questions on the quizzes that will help your grade, & he is always willing to answer any questions. TAKE HIM!!!!:)
Best business professor I have ever had at Mays. I would take him for EVERY class if I could.

Dr. McFarland is an "off the rails" professor trying to stick to the book. He's contradictory at times (talks about how grades don't matter, proceeds to give hard grades), but he is engaging and actually tries to take the time to teach. Half the grade is dependent on a group project, so get a good group! A good professor overall, but a tough one.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor McFarland is one of my most favorite professors I've had at TAMU. His class is super engaging. He is always willing to help you in whatever area you are struggling in. There is a big group project, but he sets it up so you work on it over time. He gives tough quizzes, but they really prepare you for the exam. Overall, I loved his class.

Ken is a great professor and is one of the nicest profs I've had. The class wasn't easy and the group project was a 50+ page business plan completed throughout the semester then presented at the end. However, it gave us great experience for our future careers. Read all the textbooks and listen to was he emphasizes and you'll do well. Great guy tho!

Ken is my favorite prof of college. The class was really challenging though. He is the most caring and helpful prof to help you through your team project, but warning it's vague. He tells your team to do a competitive analysis of 2 companies and expects your most professional work. Sound fun? Not if your team procrastinates or needs structure lol.

Ken is an AMAZING professor! I am so lucky and glad that I got to have him as a professor and will DEFINITELY be taking him again for MGMT466. He really cares about his students and is constantly recommending ways to get out there to be seen by job recruiters. He is very inspirational, caring, and passionate. One of my favorite professors!
